conditional_statistical_pass: All three unchanged criteria must pass under BOTH hierarchical primary and crossed sensitivity; fewer than two independent group labels is not estimable. No release qualification from development, regression, or the one-group untouched diagnostic.
crossed_sensitivity: Independently seeded replay of the same deterministic generator seed2026; draw three paired training-seed indices and one G-group draw per replicate, applying that shared group draw to all sampled seeds. This preserves common recording-group perturbations across seeds.
justification: Clarifies the originally sealed hierarchical method and adds a conservative crossed-group sensitivity before any continuation development outcomes. Same recording groups recur across seeds; no rows are removed and no threshold is weakened.
limitations: Three training seeds and few recording groups provide limited uncertainty resolution.
Bootstrap bounds are conditional on grouping metadata and available examples, not proof of population independence.
Artifact identity, numerical correctness, memory and untouched evaluation requirements are separate gates.
point_estimate: Pool all paired seed-by-example results; weight native NLL by supervised-token count and task accuracy by example count. Keep complete connected recording groups. Frozen references are fixed deterministic evaluations, not new training seeds.
primary: For each replicate draw three paired training-seed indices with replacement. For each drawn seed independently draw G connected recording groups with replacement; keep both precision arms and frozen reference paired on the identical selected examples.
quantiles: Order each metric sample; percentile p is element ceil(repetitions*p)-1, matching the archived diagnostic percentile convention. Report two-sided95% and required one-sided95% bounds.
